en.bdb: All the means for liberation are useless
If bowing only could grant liberation then the bats in the forests hang from trees upside down.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੜੀ ਮਸਾਣੀ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਿਚ ਖੁਡਾਂ ਚੂਹੇ।
verses.translit_en: maRee masaanee je milai vich khuddaa(n) choohe|

en.bdb: If liberation were achieved in the loneliness of crematories then rats should get it in their holes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੇ ਨ ਵਡੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਬਿਸੀਅਰੁ ਵਿਹੁ ਲੂਹੇ।
verses.translit_en: mile na vaddee aarajaa biseear vih loohe|

en.bdb: Longevity also does not bring it because snake during its whole long life goes on smouldering in its own poison.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਕੁਚੀਲੁ ਵਰਤੀਐ ਖਰ ਸੂਰ ਭਸੂਹੇ।
verses.translit_en: hoi kucheel varateeaai khar soor bhasoohe|

en.bdb: If dirt could make it attainable, asses and swines always remain dirty and muddy.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ਅਈਅੜ ਵਣੁ ਧੂਹੇ।
verses.translit_en: ka(n)dh mool chit laieeaai ieeaR van dhoohe|

en.bdb: If relishing over tubers and roots could provide it (liberation), then herd of animals go on hauling and eating them (they should also have attained liberation).

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾ ਹੋਵਈ ਜਿਉ ਘਰੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਬੂਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit_en: vin gur mukat naa hoviee jiau ghar vin boohe ||13||

en.bdb: As a house (in fact) is useless without door, one cannot attain liberation without Guru.
